_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: the adjusted effect of treatment is 1.0

agreement._note: In place of a second language, harness/missing_examples.test.py recomputes the pooled SE by Rubin's rules (1e-9) and the Barnard-Rubin df (relative 1e-7) and the interval from mice's pooled components, and shows complete-case analysis averaging 0.74 over the seeds while MI averages 0.99.

recovery.claim: the estimate is close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The tolerance separates the effect (1.0) from zero; complete-case bias (-0.26 on average) is caught by the control file's mean-bias assertion, not by recovery. A first fixture's missingness was too weak for complete-case analysis to be biased by more than 0.06. Measured by harness/missing_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49.
